terrain.source: Open-Meteo elevation API (Copernicus DEM GLO-90), 0.01 deg, fetched 2026-10-27

cover.source: Hansen et al. (2013), GFC-2023-v1.11, tile 60N_010W: treecover2000 with loss 2001-2018 removed; mean canopy cover (%) per 0.005 deg cell, rows from north to south
